title: Live agents, event-driven work, and realtime state
subtitle: Keep long-lived assistants responsive, bounded, and recoverable.
goal: Keep an agent useful while the world changes
intro: A live agent must reject stale work and remain responsive through interruptions, overload, and reconnection.
case: The user changes the destination while a draft is being generated.
Only output based on the new intent may become current.
An older response may arrive later and overwrite the correction.
